prompt: Create a polished product-style architecture infographic for the Luminarr project. Title in Chinese: Luminarr 项目结构总览. Show four private-chat entry channels across the top: Telegram, personal WeChat, Feishu, WeCom. Route them into one shared runtime layer, then into services, then clients and SQLite truth, then external systems. The flow should clearly show: channels -> shared runtime -> services -> clients/db -> external systems. Include these external systems as labeled nodes: TMDB, Prowlarr, Transmission, qBittorrent, Emby, Jellyfin, Plex. Make SQLite visually prominent as the only source of truth. Add a small movie-first workflow strip: 搜索 -> 下载审批 -> 导入审批 -> 刷新. Use a clean editorial infographic style, light background, subtle grid, strong spacing, modern sans typography, restrained accent colors, mostly Chinese labels with a few English technical labels such as shared runtime, services, clients, SQLite. No web dashboard, no fake analytics, no purple cyberpunk, no dark-mode poster look.
composition: landscape architecture poster with layered boxes and arrows, centered hierarchy, readable labels
constraints: Chinese-first labels, no nonexistent features, no web UI, no buttons, no watermark
